entry.title: TIDAL FOR Datum Dahleez LUXURY BESPOKE LOUD SPEAKERS - THE "ROYALE" SERIES
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Exclusive lifestyle
Price: 345000.00

The most advanced and complex cabinet Tidal have ever designed and built - the internal multichannel amplifier with sheer endless power and silky finesse, equivalent to the Datum Dahleez W16 engine, it is incredibly engineered. The diaphragms are made out of components such as diamond, ceramic and light-metals to make these speakers completely unique. The ‘Royale’ model comes in various configurations and finishes, being in line with the spirit of Datum Dahleez’s cars and the uniqueness that the brand embodies.There are two main cabinet themes: Monococque and Duotone.

Individuality - or as we call it: ATELIER. Just like the Datum Dahleez models on give an almost infinite number of possibilities for customization, the options list out of materials, surfaces and colors for this new standard of home audio is equally as unique. The seductive curves and brilliant finish of the Royale speakers and the controller are embellished with jewel-like details in a variety of materials to be heavily customized with carbon fibre, fabric, leather, polished stainless steel, dark aluminum and precious-metal surfaces.

The choices for the components are the metal parts, divided in three groups: aluminium, stainless-steel and precious metal designs. Either velvet glass-pearl blasted, brushed or structured, silver, grey or dark and all colours in between – the aluminium package offers almost endless possibilities.

The side grills can also be customised, for example the front-plate can be selected in the above mentioned various metals or carbon fibre and leather components.

Speaker Specifications:

- 4-way hybrid-active powered ultra high end loudspeaker

- 100% zero latency analogue signal paths • upgradeable for longevity and sustainability

- TIRALIT™ Polycast monocoque cabinet (MONOCOQUE) and dual-shell cabinet (DUOTONE)

- 1 x 30 mm diamond tweeter

- 1 x 127 mm diamond midrange-woofer

- 2 x 170 mm front woofers with aluminum-magnesium diaphragm

- 4 x 265 mm long throw subwoofers with aluminum-magnesium diaphragm

- Connection inputs: XLR, ROYALE-Link, power cord input, LAN power remote

- Adjustments: Bass Tone & Bass Level

- Recommended source: TIDAL for Datum Dahleez “Royale MC-1” and „Royale MP-1“

- Speaker dimensions and weight: 144 cm x 28 cm x 60 cm, 2 x 218 Kg (without packaging)

Music Controller “ROYALE MC 1” Specifications:

- Fully discrete digital to music converter (DMC™) with lossless volume control and streaming unit

- Upgradeable for longevity and sustainability • individual choices of the metal cabinet (aluminum colours and finishes)

- Individual choices of the top cover inlay and side panel inlays (metals, carbon fibre, leather, colours)

- Controlled via remote control and iOS or Android devices, Multi-Room

- Digital sources input: USB storage, flash drive, hard disk, RJ45 network 1000Base-T, UPnP AV protocol

- Streaming services: Spotify Connect, Tidal Connect, Qobuz, TuneIn Radio, Apple AirPlay

- SPDIF digital in: Toslink, BNC, RCA, AES. Optional: WISA, HDMI, IP-based • Formats: PCM (FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC), DSD

- Dimensions and weight: 46 cm x 42 cm x 12 cm, 1 x 28 Kg (without packaging)

Reviews:

“2023 witnesses perhaps the most important year in the field of high end audio reproduction. This year marks a tipping point that separates the history of audio into two parts: a time before the TIDAL for Datum Dahleez ‚Royale‘ and a time after the TIDAL for Datum Dahleez ‚Royale‘. With this unique audio system, TIDAL moves into a realm of realistic playback that has not been achieved before, or even thought possible. Moreover, the attention to detail and quality of workmanship is unparalleled, singularly reminiscent of the mechanical work of Swiss chronograph manufacturers. All in all, the TIDAL for Datum Dahleez Royale represents the pinnacle of current audio reproduction possibilities”. - FIDELITY

“Without reservation, I can say that the Royale system is the most transparent and lifelike audio system that I’ve ever heard… The rendering was ultra-detailed from the nano-to-macro-level. It seemed that the soundstage and performers were holographically projected in space. Not only was I astounded with what I heard but I was instantly moved to emotion. Bar none – the Datum Dahleez by TIDAL Royale system was undeniable the best sound heard at the HIGH END SHOW, a game changer in high-end audio.” - TRENDS Technics & Design
